name: nc-bioinformatics-figure-skills
description: An Agent workflow for plotting and reviewing existing single-cell and communication results with ncfigR, scfigR and commfigR, traceable source data, checks and bounded corrections.

interface.shortDescription: 调用 R 包绘制已有单细胞结果，检查图件、保留源数据并按报告修正。
interface.longDescription: Plot existing annotated single-cell results through a version-checked ncfigR/scfigR/commfigR runtime. The Agent executes atlas or existing-communication tasks, reads checks, reviews exported artwork and makes bounded presentation corrections without silently changing scientific inputs. Other plotting domains and paper/code learning remain on-demand references rather than equivalent validated task engines.
defaultPrompt: Use nc-bioinformatics-figure-skills to plot and review existing single-cell results through the fixed ncfigR/scfigR runtime. Inspect inputs, execute the task, review reports and artwork, then correct presentation in a new attempt. Load paper/code learning, broader figure planning or other-domain references only when the user explicitly requests them.
